messages:
maria.sales: Heads-up: Solstice Capital wants a POC compliance bundle by next Wed. They asked for: SOC2 system description (short), an ISO/network diagram, a signed pen-test acceptance letter, confirmation well allow a third-party vuln scan against staging, and whether we can stream MFA/auth logs to their SIEM for 30 days. They want pricing impact on Dedicated single-tenant.

chris.se: Clarifying q is the POC Dedicated? If so we can provide allowlist IPs for a timed scan window. For SIEM: we can stream telemetry (auth success/fail counts, timestamps, user-id hashes), but not full user content.

oakley.security: Correct. If they want MFA/event logs that include user identifiers we need DPA sign-off and product approval. We can provide hashed identifiers + event types by default. Raw auth logs would require a scoped DPA addendum.

dana.legal: Pen-test attestation: we have a standard template we can sign. If Solstice sends their vendor template with indemnity edits, expect legal review 3-5 business days. Also need to confirm whether they require our exec-level signature or legal alone.

maria.sales: They asked for CISO-signed pen-test acceptance. Can Legal sign and we stamp with Security? That should be OK?

dana.legal: We can usually sign as Legal; if they insist on CISO we can route but it may add delay. Ask them to accept Legal + Security stamp to speed up.

beau.ops: Ops notes: for scan access we do a time-boxed window (2-4 hours) with ephemeral creds and IP allowlist. We'll need 24-48h notice to provision staging IPs and firewall rules. Presigned upload for evidence is easiest for dataroom. Example upload: 
```bash
curl -X PUT "https://storage.redwood.example/evidence/solstice/poc-bundle.zip?X-Amz-Signature=..." -H "Content-Type: application/zip" --data-binary @poc-bundle.zip
```

infra-bot: presign request template available. Use the ops API to generate one-off links.

chris.se: Also callout KMS: if they want customer-managed keys for Dedicated, we need the key thumbprint and a quick handshake. That impacts ops provisioning (~1 business day) and pricing maybe a small setup fee.

oakley.security: Also: external vuln scan raw reports may leak internal hostnames; we redact internal hostnames/IPs unless they provide a signed NDA allowing them. We can provide a sanitized report by default.

maria.sales: Pricing: they want SIEM streaming + 30d retention included. Any rough numbers so I can reply?

beau.ops: Ballpark: Dedicated baseline +$11k/mo, one-time setup $3k, SIEM streaming & storage +$950/mo for 30d, scan-window provisioning one-time $600. KMS customer-managed +$400 one-time. If they want prompt-level or full payload retention thats significantly more.

dana.legal: Action items: I'll prepare the pen-test attestation ready for signature (Legal signature + Security stamp) and flag any CISO-sign requests. ETA 48h if they accept our template.

ochris.se: I'll assemble the ISO/network diagram (template) and a small control mapping doc showing which SOC2 controls we can share. ETA 24h.

maria.sales: Great. Final blockers for customer call: 1) confirm DPA for MFA logs, 2) accept pen-test template (or allow Legal sign), 3) ops presigned link + scan window timing. If any of those slip they may pause kickoff. :warning:

infra-bot: Firewall ticket created (#FW-12034). Ops will post presigned upload link in #eng-infra within 3 hours.
